source_scope: 16-page A1/A2 preview: contents for 40 units and 10 scenarios, with sample lessons. Most word selections are assistant recommendations, not a fully extracted textbook glossary.
word_policy: Individual words only. Lowercase NFC; compounds with hyphens retained. Proper names use lowercase storage; original capitalization is in the extracted backup.

enrichment.english_and_ukrainian: 439 new word translations prepared by the assistant; 350 existing database translations reused unchanged. New translations have not received independent human review.
enrichment.levels: New CEFR labels are assistant estimates for individual words, not publisher-assigned levels. Existing levels are retained.
enrichment.groups: Course group, one group per book unit/practical scenario, editorial A1 starting group, and compatible existing topic groups.
enrichment.a1_group_note: Membership represents the suggested starting path, not a guarantee that the word has an official A1 label.
enrichment.contextual_senses: Eight existing polysemous words have additional contextual meanings in per-word notes; their stored translations are not overwritten.
enrichment.normalization: Lowercase NFC; no phrases; no mastery values are supplied.
